early-scan.measurement: sampled managed-thread stack residence; overlapping threads, not exact CPU, wall, or physical disk time
qualifications: The all-thread denominator includes idle service/threadpool/event-loop residence.
The filesystem-callback denominator excludes background/idle threads by requiring a named FileSystemHost or WinFspOverlayFileSystem callback frame.
Callback percentages also exclude helper I/O work on other threads and stacks without a named callback; this is not all non-idle work.
Inclusive method/context times overlap and must not be added together.
Monitor entry context identifies visible callers, not the actual lock object; JIT inlining can omit product frames.
Leaf labels identify sampled method names, not whether that thread consumed CPU throughout each sample interval.
CPU_TIME and UNMANAGED_CODE_TIME synthetic leaf markers are excluded from method ranking.

measurementLimits: Unity, Bee and provider phase scopes overlap and are nonadditive.
Win32 CPU seconds accumulate threads, not wall-clock time.
Win32 I/O transfer bytes include pipes/devices and cache traffic; they are not physical disk bytes.
Two-second process observations omit short-lived or inaccessible processes and final counter tails. Deltas are lower bounds.
Provider inner/outer deltas use actual observedAt endpoints with explicit boundary offsets; no interpolation.
Private-byte peaks are observed sample peaks, not full-system peak memory.
Command-line role classification is only available for identity-matched observed command lines.
Process ancestry attributes ownership, not every caller of a compiler server; server CPU is not attributed to individual compilation requests.
Bee event names and durations preserve event scope; absolute trace timestamp alignment is not assumed.
EventPipe is sampled overlapping thread residence, not CPU attribution or removable wall time.
GetProcessIoCounters transfer bytes include pipes/device/cache reads and are not physical disk bytes or exact decoded blob bytes.
Git process identities include Windows launcher/child pairs and missed short processes, not decoder-start counts.
No source edits, new Play/Test/build, whole physical allocation/RAM peak or OS failure qualification.
Post-startup analysis/log copies overlap shutdown/reclamation; cleanup is not an isolated performance comparison.
